{{Quote|Captain, I'd like to introduce you to Vaz Tanriff. He's, ah, how do I say this delicately...?"<br />"I rob ships.|Darmas Polloran and Vaz Traniff|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vaz Traniff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the opening stages of the conflict, [[Darmas Pollaran]] arranged for Traniff and his friend [[Combo]] to team up with a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to [[Raid on the King's Ransom|raid]] the Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
In [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]], Traniff teamed up with the legendary [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] later known as the [[Voidhound]], credited for finding [[Nok Drayen]]'s treasure, to raid an Imperial treasury [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']]. However, in order to accomplish this, they first had to rescue Traniff's vault cracker, [[Combo]], who was being held by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and about to be sold to [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]]. Traniff arrived after Voidhound interrupted the exchange between Rogun's man, [[Strilth]], and [[Raskurro]] the Hutt. He suggested that they kill everyone, including Raskurro, to set the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] against Rogun but the Voidhound refused. Raskurro agreed to slither away while Rogun's men were killed.

Now free to begin their mission, Traniff and Combo hide in a cargo container while the Voidhound flew them to the ''King's Ransom'' in a stolen Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. But just after they started raiding the vaults, the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] opened fire on the ship in response to the Voidhound's presence. The smuggler narrowly escaped the treasury ship's destruction alive. Once back on the Smuggler's Moon, Traniff expressed confusion as to why the Voidwolf would turn on his own people. He and the Voidhound then split their plunder evenly.
{{Endgame}}
